metadata.title: Privacy Policy | Utils Plane
metadata.description: Learn how Utils Plane handles local processing, server processing, retention, account rights, and network risks during the public beta.

privacy.title: Privacy Policy
privacy.intro: This policy explains how Utils Plane handles files, accounts, and technical data during the public beta. Tools may run locally in your browser or on the server; review the processing location and retention notice before you begin.

sections.title: 1. Local browser processing
paragraphs: Tools marked as local read and generate files in the current browser. The file contents are not intentionally uploaded to the Utils Plane server for that processing. Your browser may still use memory, temporary cache, or the downloads folder to complete the operation.
Closing the page, clearing site data, or running short of browser resources can remove results that you have not downloaded. Save outputs you need promptly.

sections.title: 2. Server processing
paragraphs: When you explicitly select server processing, or a task can only run on the server, input files, processing settings, and output files are transferred to the server. The interface identifies sign-in requirements, task status, and retention behavior.
Signed-in users can save files and task history to an account. Anonymous processing does not automatically become an account file.

sections.title: 3. Accounts and authentication cookies
paragraphs: Sign-in uses Better Auth to manage sessions. Essential authentication cookies keep you signed in, reduce session misuse, and complete account requests. Disabling these cookies prevents sign-in features from working correctly.
We also process the registration email, display name, email verification status, and records needed to complete account actions.

sections.title: 4. File retention and deletion
items: Inputs and outputs for anonymous server tasks expire after 24 hours and stop being accessible; a scheduled cleanup job then deletes expired objects.
Account files remain until the user deletes them, closes the account, or the service ends processing.
Account files moved to trash remain for 30 days and are then permanently deleted; users can permanently delete them earlier.
Files produced by local browser processing are retained by the user's device and browser.

sections.title: 5. Export, deletion, and account closure
paragraphs: Signed-in users can download a ZIP data export from Settings. It includes the profile, tasks, and active or trashed files.
Permanent account closure deletes the profile, sessions, tasks, and all active or trashed files and cannot be undone. When deletion takes time, the interface shows its state or a retry action.

sections.title: 6. Observability data and optional AI
paragraphs: The current beta does not integrate product analytics, error tracking, or session replay services. Basic server logs may still contain request time, path, status code, and source IP for operation and troubleshooting, with retention limited according to operational needs.

AI features are optional. Relevant inputs are sent to the configured AI service only when the user actively selects that mode. Review that service's handling terms and do not submit material that is unsuitable for third-party processing.

sections.title: 7. IP address and HTTP access warning
paragraphs: Some beta deployments may be reached through an IP address over plain HTTP. HTTP does not protect content from observation or modification on the same network and must not be treated as a secure channel for production or sensitive material.

When accessing the service through IP + HTTP, do not upload identity, financial, medical, confidential business, or other sensitive content. Use only test material whose exposure risk you can accept, on a network you trust.

sections.title: 8. Operator and contact
paragraphs: Utils Plane is operated by the project team listed below. Contact the support address below with questions about data exports, deletion, accounts, or this policy, and do not attach sensitive files to the request.

metadata.title: Terms of Service | Utils Plane
metadata.description: Review the public beta terms for acceptable use, content responsibility, result verification, availability, and termination.

terms.title: Terms of Service
terms.intro: By using Utils Plane, you agree to follow these public beta terms. If you do not agree, stop using the service and delete any data you have saved.

sections.title: 1. Beta service
paragraphs: Utils Plane is currently offered as a free public beta. Tools, limits, signed-in enhancements, and processing methods may change as testing continues and do not constitute a production-service commitment.
Processing location, retention, and sign-in notices describe current behavior. We will update the relevant interface or terms when important behavior changes.

sections.title: 2. Content and permission responsibility
paragraphs: You must have the rights and permissions needed to upload, edit, convert, export, or share each file. You are responsible for the content, processing instructions, and use of outputs.
Do not treat the service as your only backup. Keep original files and any independent copies you need before processing.

sections.title: 3. Prohibited use
items: Processing or distributing unlawful, infringing, fraudulent, harassing, or privacy-invasive content.
Uploading malicious code, bypassing access controls, probing vulnerabilities, disrupting the service, or consuming abnormal resources.
Impersonating others, fabricating authorization, or using output for misleading identity, qualification, or record claims.
Any other activity that violates applicable law, regulatory requirements, or third-party terms.

sections.title: 4. Review of results
paragraphs: Compression, format conversion, text extraction, document generation, AI assistance, and other automated processing can produce missing, misplaced, distorted, or inaccurate output.
You must review results before publishing, submitting, printing, signing, or using them for important decisions, and use professional tools or human review where appropriate.

sections.title: 5. Availability and changes
paragraphs: The beta is provided as currently available and may be interrupted by maintenance, capacity, dependent services, browser compatibility, or security response. We do not promise continuous availability, error-free operation, or fitness for a specific purpose.
To the extent permitted by law, manage risk by keeping originals, downloading results promptly, and avoiding irreplaceable content.

sections.title: 6. Suspension and termination
paragraphs: We may limit, suspend, or terminate access for violations of these terms, harm to the service or others, abnormal load, or actions required by law.
You may stop using the service and export data or close your account in Settings. Deletion after termination follows the Privacy Policy and interface notices.

sections.title: 7. Operator and support
paragraphs: The service is operated by the project team listed below. Contact the support address below with questions about these terms, account restrictions, or the beta.

metadata.description: Review Utils Plane's free local tools, signed-in enhancements, retention rules, and IP + HTTP risk notice.

beta.title: Public Beta Notice
beta.intro: Utils Plane is publicly testing real file-processing workflows. This page summarizes the current free capabilities, signed-in enhancements, and boundaries to consider while using the beta.

sections.title: 1. Free local tools
paragraphs: Image, PDF, and document tools marked as local can be tested in the browser for free without signing in. File contents are not intentionally uploaded to the Utils Plane server for local processing.
Local processing is limited by device performance, browser memory, and compatibility. Download results before leaving the page.

sections.title: 2. Signed-in enhancements
paragraphs: After signing in, users can access task history, account files, server processing, higher limits, and selected advanced formats or batch options. These capabilities are available as currently shown during the beta and may change.
Signed-in enhancements describe beta access and do not promise a future service model or long-term availability.

sections.title: 3. Retention and deletion
items: Inputs and outputs for anonymous server tasks expire after 24 hours and stop being accessible; a scheduled cleanup job then deletes the expired files.
Account files remain until deletion or account closure; trashed files are permanently deleted after 30 days.
Settings provides a ZIP data export and permanent account closure controls.

sections.title: 4. Sensitive content and network warning
paragraphs: If the current deployment uses an IP address over HTTP, transmission is not protected by HTTPS and is unsuitable for production or sensitive material. Do not upload identity, financial, medical, confidential business, or other content whose exposure you cannot accept.
Use test material on a trusted network and confirm whether a file leaves the browser by checking each tool's processing-location notice.

sections.title: 5. Feedback and support
paragraphs: Contact the support address below about processing failures, accounts, data deletion, or unclear boundaries. Feedback may include reproduction steps and non-sensitive examples, but must not include real sensitive files.

metadata.title: Changelog | Utils Plane
metadata.description: Read curated, user-facing updates for each Utils Plane release.

changelog.title: Changelog
changelog.intro: A concise record of new capabilities, product improvements, and important fixes in each public release.

entries.title: First public beta release
entries.summary: Utils Plane brings file-processing tools, a local-first workflow, and signed-in account capabilities into one workbench.

groups.title: New
items: Image compression, format conversion, GIF / APNG animation, and long-image stitching prioritize browser processing; Markdown / Word documents support local editing, preview, and PDF export.
Heavy PDF operations, font conversion, and ID photo generation run as signed-in server tasks with task-history tracking.
Signed-in users get account files and ZIP data export; per-file limits follow the account plan, with the top public-beta allowance reserved for Pro Preview.

groups.title: Improved
items: Image compression now keeps the default size selected after upload, shows the full comparison, and supports repeat compression.
GIF / APNG animation compression and upload validation are more complete, with clearer large-file boundaries.
Tool pages show processing location, sign-in requirements, retention, and current limits.

groups.title: Fixed
items: APNG uploads no longer fail with a GIF-only file-type message.
Compressing another image after a successful result works again.
Plan names now show a localized description followed by the English identifier.
